description: This file contains a class 'RandomErrorInjector' implementing fault injection for transaction testing, along with nested exception classes.

classes.name: RandomErrorInjector
classes.description: A class that introduces random faults into transaction processing for testing purposes, based on specified probabilities.

classes.name: RandomlyInjectedStorageException
classes.description: Custom exception thrown when a storage fault is injected.

classes.name: RandomlyInjectedInconsistentStateException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating an inconsistent state due to injected fault.

methods.name: RandomErrorInjector
methods.description: Constructor that initializes fault probabilities based on injectionProbability.

methods.name: BeforeStore
methods.description: Method to potentially inject a storage or inconsistency fault before a store operation.

methods.name: AfterStore
methods.description: Method to potentially inject a storage fault after a store operation.

methods.name: RandomlyInjectedInconsistentStateException
methods.description: Exception thrown for inconsistent state faults.
